arrive.help: Where the player steps onto the island, from the last level's bridge

side.help: The side the bridge leaves by: 0 down, 1 left, 2 right, 3 up

par.help: Moves in the shortest solution, shown as par once the level is solved

exit.help: Where the bridge to the next level leaves, once every flower is stomped

side.help: The side the bridge leaves by: 0 down, 1 left, 2 right, 3 up
